name: Jim Halpert Pointing To Whiteboard
look: Two stacked stills from The Office. Top: Jim Halpert (John Krasinski), in a light blue shirt and dark tie, points a marker at a blank whiteboard on an easel while looking at the camera. Bottom: he sits beside the blank whiteboard and gives the camera a small, knowing smile.
use: Jim presents something on the whiteboard like a lesson, then looks at the camera with a smug smile. The top board sets up a point or plan, and the bottom board delivers the twist or conclusion he is quietly proud of.
slots: top whiteboard: the point or plan
bottom whiteboard: the twist or conclusion
examples: If I never check my bank account
Breakfast is the most important meal of the day
So I'm having it three times today
